title: Quartz-Seq
scope: Original Sasagawa 2013 Quartz-Seq implementation. Extraction covers the assigned Illumina single-cell WTA schematic through amplified cDNA, with primary-supported resolution of primer identity. Neighboring poster workflows and the paper’s Quartz-Chip branch are outside this target.

operations.description: Generate first-strand cDNA from RNA, then digest most unextended RT primer with exonuclease I. Retain these two actions as the source’s combined block.

operations.information_effect: Transcript sequence information is copied into first-strand DNA. Reducing free primer lowers the source of later primer-derived amplification byproducts.

operations.label: Add cDNA poly(A) tails and oligo(dT) tagging primer
operations.description: Add poly(A) to the 3′ ends of first-strand cDNA and introduce the PCR-target-containing oligo(dT) tagging primer for the next copying step.
operations.mechanism: Terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase adds the cDNA tail; surviving RT primers can also be tailed. The tagging primer supplies the second priming handle. Restricted tailing keeps modified residual primers amenable to subsequent suppression PCR.
operations.information_effect: Adds a second priming interface to the RNA-derived DNA without recording a new biological transcript. Tailed unused RT primers are potential nontranscript byproduct precursors.

operations.label: Enrich cDNA by suppression PCR
operations.description: Amplify transcript-derived cDNA while suppressing amplification of short primer-derived DNAs. The output is amplified double-stranded cDNA, the final material depicted.
operations.mechanism: Short DNA templates with complementary end sequences can self-associate into pan-like structures that prevent PCR-primer binding. The source reports suppression of short-fragment/byproduct enrichment while obtaining sufficient cDNA.

method_scopes.rationale: The assigned title and the Quartz-Seq row identify a single target. The primary paper confirms this route: oligo(dT)-primed RT, unused-primer digestion, cDNA 3′ poly(A) tailing and tagging-primer addition, second-strand generation, then suppression PCR. Primer addition is retained as a depicted local action, with identity corrected from LNA blocker to the original amino-modified suppression PCR primer. T7 is a primer-derived sequence here; no in vitro transcription step is depicted for Quartz-Seq. The final DNA carries transcript-derived sequence for later Illumina expression measurement. No pooling, UMI, cell barcode, readout operation, or Quartz-seq2 branch is transferred from neighboring rows. Subsequent sequencing-library preparation is an endpoint interface rather than an added graph route.

evidence.rationale: General review of tumor single-cell sequencing, assessed from the registered abstract only; no original Quartz-Seq architecture association is established.

evidence.locator: Abstract, Primer scope (registered evidence level: abstract)
evidence.quote: In this Primer, we provide an overview of available methods and discuss experimental design and single-cell data analysis.
evidence.rationale: Experimental-design and analysis background, assessed from the abstract only; it is not the original method description.

evidence.locator: Abstract, cancer genomics overview (registered evidence level: abstract)
evidence.quote: This paradigm shift has been fueled by the development of single-cell sequencing technologies, which provide a powerful new approach to study complex biological processes in human cancers.
evidence.rationale: General single-cell cancer-genomics background. The abstract does not establish a Quartz-Seq implementation, including for the duplicated poster candidate lead.

evidence.locator: Abstract, technology review scope (registered evidence level: abstract)
evidence.quote: Here, we simply summarize the techniques used for single-cell isolation, and review the current technologies used in single-cell genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic sequencing.
evidence.rationale: General technology-review background from abstract-level content; the duplicated poster candidate does not establish method-specific architecture.

evidence.locator: Abstract, zebrafish cerebellar expression study (registered evidence level: abstract)
evidence.quote: This study uses zebrafish transgenic larvae expressing fluorescent proteins in granule cells, Purkinje cells, or other cerebellar neurons and glial cells to isolate each type of cerebellar cells by fluorescence-activated cell sorting and to profile their gene expressions by RNA sequencing and in situ hybridization.
evidence.rationale: The abstract establishes an application, not its Quartz-Seq chemistry. The catalogue describes a modified cell-mass application outside the original single-cell scope; that secondary report is not primary implementation verification.

evidence.locator: Abstract, processivity-model study (registered evidence level: abstract)
evidence.quote: Analysis of new and existing (sc)RNA-seq data from six different library preparation protocols reveals that polymerase processivity is the mechanistic origin of coverage biases.
evidence.rationale: The abstract discusses multiple protocols without identifying which are Quartz-Seq; retain background with no member assignment and do not import proposed protocol modifications.

evidence.locator: Abstract, computational cell-cycle classification (registered evidence level: abstract)
evidence.quote: Here we describe and compare five established supervised machine learning methods and a custom-built predictor for allocating cells to their cell-cycle stage on the basis of their transcriptome.
evidence.rationale: Computational application/background from the abstract only; no original Quartz-Seq laboratory architecture is established.

corrections.diagram_observation: The caption says “Add polyA primer with T7 promoter and PCR target”, while the primer icon is TTTTT beside T7/PCR and the RNA has an A-rich tail.

evidence.quote: The first-strand cDNA was synthesized using the reverse transcription (RT) primer, which contains oligo-dT24, the T7 promoter (T7) and the PCR target region (M) sequences.

corrections.diagram_observation: Illumina inserts an “Add blocking primer” action after second-strand generation and explicitly labels the orange/red primer “Blocking primer with LNA”. All three supplied depictions repeat this label.
corrections.primary_statement: The original implementation adds a suppression PCR primer after second-strand synthesis; Table 1 specifies (NH2)-GTATAGAATTCGCGGCCGCTCGCGAT. The suppression mechanism is complementary-end self-association of short DNA templates that prevents primer binding. Use the amino-modified suppression primer in the connected State and Operation, rather than asserting an LNA blocker.

evidence.quote: In suppression PCR, these complementary sequences can bind to each other, and the self-bound template DNA forms a 'pan-like' structure. In addition, the DNA is not amplified by PCR because the PCR primer cannot bind to the template DNA (see Additional file 1, Figure S4).
